title: Composition of weighted restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta_1,\delta_2\in\mathbb R$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function on assignments of coordinate restrictions to the $n$ coordinates. Compose two assignments coordinatewise, with a first-stage fixed value taking precedence and a free first-stage coordinate inheriting the second-stage restriction. The weighted sum over the two stages, using parameters $\delta_1$ and $\delta_2$, of $g$ evaluated on the composed assignment equals the weighted sum of $g$ over single-stage assignments with parameter $\delta_1\delta_2$.
hypotheses_covered: δ₁ and δ₂ are arbitrary real numbers
g is a real-valued function on restriction assignments to the n coordinates
